# Slovak (`sk`)

**Base patterns:** 4. Time-of-day and trailing-text variants are generated at `DateParser` construction. See the [language overview](/languages/) for flags and format codes.

| Pattern Key | Name | Format | Min Length | Max Length | Year Short | No Year | Filter | Examples |
|-------------|------|--------|------------|------------|------------|---------|--------|----------|
| `dt:date:sk_base` | Base Slovak date with month name (nominative) | `%d %m %Y` | 9 | 18 |  |  | 1 | `15 Marec 2024`, `3 December 2023`, `28 Júl 2025` |
| `dt:date:sk_base_lc` | Base Slovak date with month name lowercase (nominative) | `%d %m %Y` | 9 | 18 |  |  | 1 | `15 marec 2024`, `3 december 2023`, `28 júl 2025` |
| `dt:date:sk_gen` | Slovak date with month name in genitive form | `%d %m %Y` | 9 | 18 |  |  | 1 | `15 Marca 2024`, `3 Decembra 2023`, `28 Júla 2025` |
| `dt:date:sk_gen_lc` | Slovak date with month name in genitive form (lowercase) | `%d %m %Y` | 9 | 18 |  |  | 1 | `15 marec 2024`, `3 december 2023`, `28 júl 2025` |
